references.text: The first commandment forbids having other gods and making carved images, which directly parallels the prohibition against turning to idols and casting graven images.
Contains an identical prohibition against making cast gods.
Declares a curse on anyone who makes carved or cast graven images, which are abominable to the Lord.
Warns against making any form of carved image or likeness, and emphasizes that the Lord is their God.
Condemns Israel for worshipping idols made by their own hands.
Mocks those who make cast images and asks who forms a god that cannot help.
Declares that all nations' gods are idols (elilim), the same word used in Leviticus 19:4.
Those who serve carved images and boast of idols shall be put to shame.
Asks what profit a carved image or cast idol has, since it is only a false teacher.
Describes turning away from idols to serve the living and true God.
